description: Source code for handling settings lines in Zephyr OS, including reading, writing, copying, and parsing configuration lines.

classes.name: settings_io_cb_s
classes.description: Structure holding callback functions for I/O operations in settings line processing.

methods.name: settings_line_write
methods.description: Writes a configuration line with a name and value to storage.

methods.name: settings_next_line_ctx
methods.description: Advances to the next line context when reading encoded length lines.

methods.name: settings_line_len_calc
methods.description: Calculates the length of a line given a name and value length.

methods.name: settings_line_raw_read_until
methods.description: Reads raw data from storage until a specific character or buffer is filled.

methods.name: settings_line_val_read
methods.description: Reads a value from a line at a specific offset.

methods.name: settings_line_val_get_len
methods.description: Gets the length of a value at a specific offset.

methods.name: settings_line_name_read
methods.description: Reads the name part of a line.

methods.name: settings_line_entry_copy
methods.description: Copies a line entry from source to destination.

methods.name: settings_line_io_init
methods.description: Initializes I/O callbacks for line processing.

methods.name: settings_line_cmp
methods.description: Compares a value with data read from a line.

methods.name: settings_line_load_cb
methods.description: Loads a configuration value using a callback.
